name: LABBench2
intro: LABBench2 是 LAB-Bench 的高保真后继基准，包含 1,912 个开放式生物学研究任务，覆盖文献理解与检索、数据访问、分子生物学、实验方案排错和实验规划，并比较无工具与网络搜索、代码执行工具增强系统。

task_type: 开放式生命科学研究任务, Agent 任务
eval_feature: 真实检索与文件输入, 工具增强, 自定义验证器
scale: 1,912 个任务 / 5 类科研能力
modality_en: Text, image, PDF, data files, biological sequences
task_type_en: Open-response life-science research tasks, agent tasks

intro_en: LABBench2 is the higher-fidelity successor to LAB-Bench. Its 1,912 open-response biology-research tasks cover literature understanding and retrieval, data access, molecular biology, protocol troubleshooting, and experiment planning, and compare base systems with web-search and code-execution augmentation.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.09554v2 Sections 2.1.1, 2.2.1, 2.3.1, 2.4.1, and 2.5 plus official EdisonScientific/labbench2 repository snapshot c028ecdc. The exact 1,912-task total comprises LitQA3 168, PatentQA 121, TrialQA 120, SourceQuality 150, DbQA2 86, SuppQA2 125, ProtocolQA2 125, SeqQA2 400, CloningQA 14, FigQA2 101 in each of image/PDF/retrieval modes, and TableQA2 100 in each mode. Literature and protocol tasks use contracted and internal domain experts with multiple review rounds; DbQA2 combines LLM analysis of 1,000 bioRxiv papers with expert curation of 43 sources; SeqQA2 expands 20 in-house-biologist templates into 20 variants each. CloningQA produces a parseable DSL and uses end-to-end in-silico validators. The diagrams preserve open-response framing, image/PDF/retrieval and inline/file/retrieval modes, task-specific graders, and the paper's base-versus-web-search-and-code-execution comparison with overall, family, mode, and subtask accuracy breakdowns.
